# DemandHub

> DemandHub is an all-in-one platform for local service businesses combining AI-powered messaging, reputation management, and appointment scheduling.

DemandHub serves healthcare, wellness, automotive, and service-based businesses with integrated tools for patient/customer communication, review management, and online booking. The platform emphasizes AI automation including AI receptionists, chatbots, and intelligent review generation to streamline operations and improve customer engagement.

## Key Topics

- AI Receptionist
- SMS & Messaging
- Review Management
- Appointment Booking
- Patient Communication
- Unified Inbox
- AI Automation
- Reputation Management
- Front Desk Automation
- CRM Integration
- Web Chat
- Patient Reactivation
- Healthcare Software
- Lead Management
- AI Agent

## Core Platform & Products

- [DemandHub: Reviews, Messaging & Lead Management for Local Business](https://www.demandhub.co): DemandHub homepage: text messaging, reviews, and lead management for local businesses
- [Messenger: One Inbox for All Patient Messages](https://www.demandhub.co/products/messenger): DemandHub Messenger: unified inbox for SMS, chat, social, and email with analytics
- [Business Text Messaging Service & Platform | Connect All Message Channels | DemandHub](https://www.demandhub.co/products/inbox): DemandHub Inbox: unified SMS, email, Facebook, and Instagram messaging platform
- [AI-Powered Review Assistant | Automate Review Requests & Responses](https://www.demandhub.co/products/ai-reviews): DemandHub AI Reviews: automated review requests and responses across platforms
- [Online Scheduling: Patients Book Directly Online](https://www.demandhub.co/products/online-scheduling): DemandHub Online Scheduling: patient booking with real-time availability and reminders
- [Web Chat: Convert Visitors into Appointments](https://www.demandhub.co/products/webchat): DemandHub Web Chat: 24/7 AI chat converting site visitors to scheduled appointments
